reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 农场通知里还要问什么

materials.title: Farm Trip Missing Details 016
materials.text: Our class will visit a farm on Saturday. The short note does not give every detail. Choose the question that asks for the information each child needs.

questions.prompt: You need to know when the bus leaves. What do you ask?
options: What time does the bus leave?
questions.explanation: B直接问发车时刻；A问帽位置，C问苹果喜好，都未获取时间。

questions.prompt: You need to know the meeting place. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: C问集合地点；A牛龄、B唱歌许可不解决集合地点未知。

questions.prompt: You want to know if you should take lunch. What do you ask?
options: Do I need a lunch box?
questions.explanation: A问需否带午餐盒；B车色、C笔长与午餐准备无关。

questions.prompt: You do not know which shoes to wear. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: B问应穿鞋；A书位、C鸭色不解决穿鞋准备。

questions.prompt: You need to know when to come home. What do you ask?
options: What time do we come back?
questions.explanation: C问回程时刻；A河内物、B农夫跳跃能力均非返回时间。

units.title: 手工课借工具时怎样说

materials.title: Borrowed Craft Tools 016
materials.text: At craft club, children share tools. Read what each child needs and choose the useful sentence.

questions.prompt: Your glue stick is empty. You want to use the spare one. What do you say?
options: May I use the spare glue stick?
questions.explanation: A为胶棒空而请求备用；B剪刀色、C袜子色不能完成借胶需要。

questions.prompt: A friend has the only ruler. You need it after the friend finishes. What do you say?
options: May I use the ruler after you?
questions.explanation: B尊重先后请求用尺；A索取铅笔非尺且未尊先后；C窗况无关。

questions.prompt: A friend gives you scissors, but you need tape. What do you say?
options: Thank you, but may I have tape instead?
questions.explanation: C感谢后纠正所需物；A剪刀不是餐具；B藏物不澄清错给。

questions.prompt: You have finished with the class brush and want to find its place. What do you ask?
options: Where should I put this brush?
How many birds can you see?
questions.explanation: A问画笔归处；B鸟数、C足球喜好不解决归还工具位置。

questions.prompt: Your friend cannot reach a paper box. You want to help. What do you say?
options: Shall I get the box for you?
Do not use any paper again.
questions.explanation: B主动帮取够不着盒；A月位、C禁纸与需求无关。

materials.title: Missing Library Stamp 016
materials.text: I borrow a library book on Tuesday. The helper writes the return day on a card. She forgets to stamp the book. At home, I see the empty stamp space and think I cannot read it yet. Dad reads the card. It says I can keep the book until next Tuesday. I take the book back the next morning and ask the helper. She adds the stamp and says I may start reading now.

questions.prompt: The writer borrows the book on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: A正确：on Tuesday借书；B否认日期。

questions.prompt: The helper forgets to write a return day.
questions.explanation: B正确：写了归还日，忘的是印章；A混淆两种登记。

questions.prompt: The card says the book must be returned the same afternoon.
questions.explanation: B正确：until next Tuesday；A把一周后改当天下午。

questions.prompt: Dad reads the card at home.
questions.explanation: A正确：At home Dad reads card；B否认行为。

questions.prompt: The helper adds the missing stamp the next morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：次晨回问后adds stamp；B否认补盖流程。

materials.title: Paper Fan Direction 016
materials.text: We put a little paper boat in a tray of water. My brother blows on it, and it moves away from him. I use a paper fan. The boat moves faster, but it hits the side of the tray. We try smaller waves of air. Now it moves slowly through the middle. Mum asks us to wipe the water from the table before we put the game away.

questions.prompt: The paper boat floats in a tray of water.
questions.explanation: A正确：boat in tray of water；B否认场景。

questions.prompt: The boat first moves towards the brother when he blows.
questions.explanation: B正确：away from him；A方向颠倒。

questions.prompt: The first use of the fan makes the boat hit the tray side.
questions.explanation: A正确：faster but hits side；B否认首次结果。

questions.prompt: Smaller waves of air help the boat move through the middle.
questions.explanation: A正确：try smaller后moves slowly through middle；B否认调整效果。

questions.prompt: Mum asks the children to leave water on the table.
questions.explanation: B正确：asks wipe water；A把擦净说成保留。

units.title: 公园公交站的两个编号

materials.title: Bus Stop Number Change 016
materials.text: The bus stop near the park has two signs. The old sign says Stop 6, but the new city map calls it Stop 16. A small note says both numbers name the same place this month. From next month, only Stop 16 will be used. Grandma sees the old number on her route card and worries that she is at the wrong stop. I show her the note. We wait together for Bus 8. The stop number is not the bus number. Bus 8 arrives at ten twenty, and we get on.

questions.prompt: What is the stop’s new number?
questions.explanation: C新站编号16；B旧6；A为乘车线路8不是站号。

questions.prompt: What does the note say about the two stop numbers this month?
questions.explanation: A本月同站并行号；B异地、C票价均误读。

questions.prompt: Why is Grandma worried?
options: Her route card uses the old number.
questions.explanation: B旧路线卡与新号不一致；A司机、C关园无依据。

questions.prompt: Which bus do they take?
questions.explanation: C等上8路；A/B站号不等于线路。

questions.prompt: What number will be used for the stop next month?
questions.explanation: A下月仅16；B旧号停用；C线路8不是站号。

materials.title: School Flag Rope 016
materials.text: A flag rope at school has a faded mark. The caretaker uses the mark to know when the flag is high enough. He does not ask pupils to climb the pole. Instead, he lowers the rope and adds a clear new mark while standing on the ground. Before the next ceremony, he checks that the rope moves freely. Pupils stand behind the white line during the check. The flag is raised only after everyone has moved to the assembly area.

questions.prompt: The old rope mark is difficult to see.
questions.explanation: A正确：faded mark变淡；B否认待修原因。

questions.prompt: Pupils climb the pole to add the new mark.
questions.explanation: B正确：管理员地面放绳加记号，不让学生爬；A错人错动作。

questions.prompt: The caretaker checks that the rope moves freely.
questions.explanation: A正确：before next ceremony检查；B否认步骤。

questions.prompt: Pupils stand in front of the white line during the check.
questions.explanation: B正确：behind white line；A前后反转。

questions.prompt: The flag is raised after people have moved to the assembly area.
questions.explanation: A正确：only after移到集合区；B否认先后。

units.title: 社区活动通知的大字版本

materials.title: Community Print Size 016
materials.text:
Message from the community centre
A large-print version of the winter programme is now available at the front desk. It contains the same activities and dates as the standard leaflet. Because the text is larger, it uses more pages. Please do not assume that extra pages mean extra events. Staff can also read the programme aloud if requested. Bookings must still be made through the usual phone number or at the desk. The large-print leaflet is not a booking form. If you notice a difference between the two versions, tell staff so they can check both. Recycled copies of the old programme should not be used for current dates.

questions.prompt: What is different in the large-print leaflet?
questions.explanation: C字较大页更多；A/B/D同活动日期与通常预约渠道，没有费用变更。

questions.prompt: Why does the new version have more pages?
options: The larger text needs more space.
It is a separate booking form.
questions.explanation: A大字多占空间；B额外活动明说不应推定；C仍有日期；D非预约表。

questions.prompt: How can someone book?
options: Through the usual phone number or front desk.
By keeping the large-print copy at home.
By writing only on an old programme.
questions.explanation: B原电话或前台；A页数、C保留手册、D旧节目纸都不构成预约。

questions.prompt: What should readers do if versions disagree?
questions.explanation: D报告员工核对；A猜、B忽略、C自动用旧均非规则。

questions.prompt: What other help is offered?
options: A private taxi for every visitor.
questions.explanation: A可请求朗读；B出租车、C免约票、D每页新日程均未提供。

materials.title: Soap Project Measure 016
materials.text: Our class checked soap use beside the washbasins. We marked the level in each bottle every afternoon for a week. The bottle near the playground emptied fastest. One pupil said children there must wash their hands more carefully. The caretaker showed us that its pump released more soap with each press. Another bottle had a small leak. We added these details to our notes. The levels told us how much soap had left the bottles, but they did not prove how well anyone washed. For the next week, the caretaker fitted matching pumps and fixed the leak before we compared the bottles again.

questions.prompt: The class recorded bottle levels every afternoon.
questions.explanation: A正确：every afternoon for a week；B否认记录频率。

questions.prompt: The fastest-emptying bottle proved the best handwashing.
questions.explanation: B正确：泵量和漏液影响用量，不证明质量；A把耗量当洗手好坏。

questions.prompt: The playground pump released more soap per press.
questions.explanation: A正确：more each press；B否认设备差异。

questions.prompt: The class ignored the leaking bottle.
questions.explanation: B正确：记录并下周修漏；A说忽略不符。

questions.prompt: Matching pumps and repairing the leak were part of the next comparison.
questions.explanation: A正确：fitted matching pumps fixed leak before compare；B否认控制改进。

materials.title: Heritage Name Pronunciation 016
materials.text:
The language club prepared a walking guide to old street names. A map listed a name in writing, but the pupils did not know how local residents pronounced it. A computer voice gave one reading. Two long-term residents used another. The group first thought it had to choose one and call the other wrong.
Their teacher suggested asking where each form was used. The map office said its guide followed the official written form. Residents explained that an older local form was still common in conversation. The pupils recorded both, with the speakers’ permission, and labelled the contexts. They did not claim that two interviews represented every resident. On the final guide, visitors could hear the official guide form and a local spoken form. A note invited further information from the neighbourhood archive.

questions.prompt: What problem did the pupils face?
options: The map had no street names.
Written and locally spoken versions were read differently.
questions.explanation: B文字计算机读法与居民读法不同；A图有名；C居民有话；D可获许可录。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher suggest checking?
options: How to remove every old word.
The contexts in which the forms were used.
questions.explanation: C问各形式使用场景；A音量、B删旧词、D价格非方法。

questions.prompt: How did the pupils present the two forms?
questions.explanation: A区分官方导览与本地口语；B不是不解释同一；C可听；D未全判居民错。

questions.prompt: What limit did the pupils acknowledge?
options: Maps could never have any use.
Two interviews did not represent all residents.
questions.explanation: D明确不夸两访谈代表全体；A地图有用；B无永不变；C未认计算机全代表。

questions.prompt: What condition applied to recording the speakers?
options: They had to buy the guide.
They had to change their names.
questions.explanation: B：with speakers permission；A无条件错误；C买导览、D改名均未要求。

units.title: 食堂选择牌上的售罄信息

materials.title: Canteen Choice Board 016
materials.text:
The canteen displayed three lunch choices on a board. Pupils placed a coloured counter beside their chosen meal before morning lessons. The kitchen used the counts to plan portions. On Tuesday, one ingredient delivery was late. Meal B could not be made. Staff removed its picture at the serving counter, but the morning board still showed it. Several pupils queued expecting that meal.
The manager apologised and updated both boards. She also introduced a check: whenever a meal changed, one worker would update the serving sign and another would check the morning board. The counters remained useful for planning, but they could not guarantee that every planned ingredient would arrive. Pupils who needed an individually checked meal continued to receive that service separately.

questions.prompt: The counters helped the kitchen estimate planned meal choices.
questions.explanation: A正确：早晨选择计数用于plan portions；B否认规划用途。

questions.prompt: Meal B was unavailable because no pupil had chosen it.
questions.explanation: B正确：原料配送晚，不是无人选；A错置缺餐原因。

questions.prompt: Only the serving-counter sign was updated at first.
questions.explanation: A正确：最初移餐台图，早晨板仍旧；B否认信息不同步。

questions.prompt: The new check required both information points to be reviewed after a change.
questions.explanation: A正确：一更新餐台，另一核早晨板；B否认双点程序。

questions.prompt: The manager claimed that counters could guarantee every delivery.
questions.explanation: B正确：计数不能保证原料到达；A将规划工具夸为配送保证。
